sloka: दानव इन्द्रो मधुर् नाम वीर्य उत्सिक्तो दुरासदः ।विगृह्य वशम् आनीतः कुम्भीनस्याः सुख आवहः ॥६-७-८॥।।
transliteration: dānava indro madhur nāma vīrya utsikto durāsadaḥ ।vigṛhya vaśam ānītaḥ kumbhīnasyāḥ sukha āvahaḥ ॥6-7-8॥।।

translations.english: "Causing terrific disturbance to the hordes of Yakshas and taking them as prisoners, you have brought the great aerial chariot from mount Kailas."
